2.fast_track: Available. Free for Star Alliance Gold/business class. Otherwise pay for Heathrow Fast Track from £8 (book online).

peak_hours: Roughly 06:00-09:00 and 16:00-20:00 daily. Avoid these if you can.
general_tips: Allow at least 60 minutes from terminal entry to gate, even off-peak.
All liquids in carry-on must be in containers of 100 ml or less (UK rule still in force at most lanes).
Where new CT scanners are deployed, you can leave laptops, tablets, and liquids in your bag — but only in those lanes; staff will direct you.
Heathrow Fast Track passes can be booked online from about £8 per person.
Premium cabins and frequent flyer status (Emerald, Gold, Elite Plus) usually include free Fast Track.
